statement: A growing share of Nvidia demand is supported by Nvidia itself guaranteeing or financing customer purchases, including a discussed $350 billion facility for OpenAI chip purchases and a backstop of OpenAI data-center debt.
why: When the seller funds the buyer, reported demand depends on the seller staying willing and able to extend credit, so the same order book carries more credit risk than arms-length demand.

impact.mechanism: Vendor financing pulls purchases forward and supports near-term volumes, but concentrates counterparty and refinancing risk that could reverse demand if credit conditions tighten.

evidence.excerpt: Nvidia guaranteeing more of OpenAI's data center debt deepens vendor financing that's already under scrutiny.

confidence.basis: Secondary syndicated report quoting analysts; company disputes the characterization and no filing confirms terms.
